# Inherited arrangement changes further copying

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`inherited-structural-copying` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F10 · [record](inherited-structural-copying.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Copies made in turn from one pool are all released exactly when it supplies the words together and the support covers their draws and releases, in any order; under local draws a word's use depends on the law only through its length and unlike adjacent pairs, so retained order changes what is drawn.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. For every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws, a pool supplies a word where it holds each token at least as often as the word uses it. A copy of a word completes, its product what was built followed by the word, exactly when the pool supplies it and the support covers its attachments' draws; with r more free to release it, exactly when the pool supplies it and the support covers the draws and r. (`Becoming.Copying.Supplies`, `Becoming.Copying.completes_iff`, `Becoming.Copying.built_iff`, `Becoming.Copying.releases_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Read as a process, a copy's moves go along the orbit of its determined law, and a plan of as many moves as the word has tokens completes with the word appended to the product exactly when the pool supplies the word and the support covers its draws. (`Becoming.Courses.steps_orbit`, `Becoming.Courses.copy_built_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. Copying words in turn from one shared pool and support, each from no previous token, and releasing each copy that completes with r free: every copy is released exactly when the pool supplies all the words joined together and the support covers all their draws and releases. Exchanging two adjacent words, which generates every reordering, keeps whether every copy is released. (`Becoming.Copying.batch`, `Becoming.Copying.batch_all_iff`, `Becoming.Copying.batch_all_swap`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. A pool supplies one word followed by another exactly when it supplies the first and what is left once the first is taken supplies the second. (`Becoming.Copying.supplies_append_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Read as courses, the release law copies a word from the pool and support held and releases it where it completes with r free, making no move where it does not; every copy of a batch is released exactly when its words are a course of the release law, so exactly when the pool supplies them together and the support covers their draws and releases. (`Becoming.Courses.release`, `Becoming.Courses.every_released_iff_course`, `Becoming.Courses.release_course_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. A lineage, one word copied n times in turn from one shared pool and support, is released copy by copy, and is a course of the release law, exactly when the pool holds each token at least n times as often as the word uses it and the support covers n times the word's draws and release. (`Becoming.Copying.lineage_all_iff`, `Becoming.Courses.lineage_course_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. Under local draws, the first attachment drawing first and each further one same after a like token and differ after an unlike one, a word of one token followed by l more uses, with same times its unlike adjacent pairs, first plus same times l plus differ times its unlike pairs: its use depends on the law only through its length and its unlike pairs. (`Becoming.Copying.pairDraw`, `Becoming.Copying.use_word`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
8. Among words of one length under local draws, one with strictly more unlike adjacent pairs than another draws less exactly when an unlike attachment draws less than a like one; and where the unlike pairs of three such words are in arithmetic progression, so are their uses. (`Becoming.Copying.use_lt_iff`, `Becoming.Copying.use_midpoint`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
9. In the structural copy machine one move is one core move, its draws the core's local draws with first draw 1. For a nonempty template strand whose bonds are the path on its tokens, copying reproduces its tokens exactly when the pool supplies them and the support covers the draws, and the strand is copied and released exactly when the support also covers one more unit, for every pool. (`Becoming.CopyingInstances.draw_eq`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.view_tick`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.copy_cells_iff`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.reproduce_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
10. For a nonempty template strand whose bonds are the path on its tokens, with its own tokens and any tail in the pool, the strand is copied and released exactly when the free support covers its draws plus one: the machine's earlier law of the support needed. (`Becoming.CopyingInstances.template_pool_reproduce_iff`, `StructuralCopying.exact_reproduction_budget`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
11. For the alternating, clustered and mixed strands of four tokens, the alternating strand draws less than the clustered one exactly when an unlike attachment draws less than a like one; the mixed strand's draws plus one are the mean of the other two's; and two laws giving the alternating and clustered strands the same draws give the mixed strand the same. (`Becoming.CopyingInstances.local_ranking_from_law`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.third_structure_from_law`, `StructuralCopying.third_structure_cost_constraint`, `StructuralCopying.two_costs_determine_third`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
12. Reproducing nonempty strands whose bonds are the path on their tokens in turn from one shared pool is the core's batch with release 1, flag for flag and supply for supply: every strand is released exactly when the pool supplies all their tokens together and the support covers all their draws and releases, and exchanging two adjacent strands keeps this. (`Becoming.CopyingInstances.batch_view`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.batch_all_released_iff`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.batch_all_released_swap`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
13. For every pool and support, every reproduction of a lineage of n from a nonempty path-shaped strand is released exactly when the pool holds each token at least n times as often as the strand uses it and the free support covers n times its draws and release; the lineage then holds n + 1 copies of the parent, and its support used grows by n times the draws and release exactly when every reproduction is released. (`Becoming.CopyingInstances.AllReleased`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.lineage_released_iff`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.lineage_of_released`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.lineage_used_iff`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
14. For a nonempty path-shaped template strand, with n copies of its tokens and any tail in the pool and the free support raised by n times the draws and release, a lineage of n yields n + 1 copies of the parent, leaving the tail and the free support: the earlier finite-lineage theorem, the lineage law's sufficient side. Every lineage keeps the tokens in strands and pool together, and the free and used support together. (`StructuralCopying.finite_lineage_inherits`, `Becoming.CopyingInstances.finite_lineage_instance`, `StructuralCopying.lineage_accounts`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
15. Read on the strands alone the converse fails, in a witness: with support for the copy but not for its release, a lineage of one from the alternating strand holds two copies of the parent while its reproduction is not released. (`Becoming.CopyingInstances.strands_do_not_show_release`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
16. In witnesses of the machine where an unlike attachment draws less: an exchange turns the alternating strand into the clustered one, which is then copied and released from the pool; from one shared pool the strand copied first is released and the second not, in either order, so the clustered strand, which draws more, can be released first; and a complete copy need not be released. (`StructuralCopying.formed_variant_enters_copying`, `StructuralCopying.shared_supply_order_matters`, `StructuralCopying.full_copy_need_not_be_released`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
17. With a like attachment drawing less, the ranking reverses in a witness: from the same pool and six units of support the clustered strand is reproduced and the alternating one is not. (`StructuralCopying.changed_local_law_reverses_advantage`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- A nonempty path template admits ordered exact access; equal/unequal adjacency draws, exchange, release and occurrence order are supplied.
- The general sufficiency/necessity theorem uses the template sequence plus a residual tail as stock; attachment consumes material, with one support unit each for first attachment and release.
- The core laws hold for every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws; the machine's tokens are Boolean and its counts of tokens and support natural numbers.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Reading and its fidelity, the physicochemical values of the draws, the occurrence of mutation, an autonomous feed and invasion of a population do not follow from these laws.
- The constraint on the third arrangement, beyond independently fitted coefficients, does not set this model apart from a strong conventional model with the same local mechanism, which has it too.
- **Counterexample:** Shared-stock order can release the arrangement that draws more first; a complete copy need not be released, and changed local draws can reverse the ranking. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/StructuralCopying.lean)
- **Counterexample:** strands_do_not_show_release: with support for the copy but not for its release, a lineage of one holds two copies of the parent while its reproduction is not released, so read on the strands alone the converse of the finite-lineage theorem fails. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/CopyingInstances.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise is used. The core declarations use no Lean axiom; the periphery declarations cited use only Lean's standard axioms (propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice), as their receipts report. · Stated for discrete steps. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation.
